name: ADX & MA
summary: This EA combines the ADX indicator with a Moving Average to identify and trade trending markets. It enters long positions when ADX confirms a strong trend and price is above the MA, and enters short positions when ADX confirms a strong trend and price is below the MA. The strategy aims to capture directional moves while filtering out ranging or weak-trend market conditions.
summary_zh: 该EA结合ADX指标与移动平均线来识别并交易趋势市场。当ADX确认强趋势且价格在MA上方时做多，当ADX确认强趋势且价格在MA下方时做空。该策略旨在捕捉方向性行情，同时过滤震荡或弱趋势市场条件。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于趋势跟踪，使用ADX指标衡量趋势强度，结合移动平均线判断趋势方向。入场条件为：ADX值超过设定阈值表示趋势足够强劲，同时价格与MA的关系决定做多或做空方向——价格上穿MA做多，下穿MA做空。出场条件通常包括反向信号触发或固定止损/止盈水平，当ADX回落至阈值以下或价格反向穿越MA时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA缺乏动态风险调整机制，如根据ATR调整止损距离或根据账户余额动态调整仓位。整体策略逻辑清晰但相对简单，适合单边趋势行情，在震荡市中可能产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend following, using the ADX indicator to measure trend strength combined with a Moving Average to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require the ADX value to exceed a configured threshold, confirming sufficient trend strength, while the price relationship to the MA dictates trade direction — going long when price crosses above the MA and short when it crosses below. Exit conditions typically involve a reverse signal trigger or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels, closing positions when ADX falls below the threshold or price reverses across the MA. Position sizing uses either a fixed lot size or an equity-proportional calculation method. Money management lacks dynamic risk adjustment mechanisms such as ATR-based stop-loss distance or account-balance-adaptive position sizing. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simplistic, performing well in trending markets while potentially generating frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging conditions.

parameters.name: ADX_Threshold
parameters.description: ADX趋势强度阈值，高于此值视为有效趋势

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; close on cumulative profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number; 0 to manage all orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调参
ADX过滤弱趋势行情，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
结合趋势强度与方向两个维度，入场条件较严谨
适用于多种时间框架，灵活性较好
代码结构相对简洁，便于二次开发和优化
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and tune parameters
ADX filters out weak-trend markets, reducing false signals in ranging conditions
Combines both trend strength and direction dimensions for stricter entry conditions
Applicable to multiple timeframes with good flexibility
Relatively clean code structure, convenient for further development and optimization
cons: 缺乏动态止损机制，固定止损无法适应市场波动性变化
没有新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下交易成本可能过高
ADX是滞后指标，入场信号可能延迟导致错过最佳入场位
震荡行情中仍可能产生连续亏损，缺乏行情适应性调整
cons_en: Lacks dynamic stop-loss mechanism; fixed SL cannot adapt to market volatility changes
No new bar check, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
Missing spread filter, trading costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
ADX is a lagging indicator, entry signals may be delayed causing missed optimal entries
May still produce consecutive losses in ranging markets without market-regime adaptation
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损距离
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，防止重复开仓和高成本交易
增加仓位管理模块，根据账户风险比例动态计算手数
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit to automatically adjust stop distances based on market volatility
Implement new bar check and spread filter to prevent repeated position opening and high-cost trades
Add position sizing module to dynamically calculate lot size based on account risk percentage

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致仓位失控
固定止损为0时可能无限亏损，缺乏硬性风险底线
ADX滞后性可能导致在趋势末期入场，增加反转风险
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause multiple position openings on the same bar leading to position overflow
Fixed stop-loss of 0 may result in unlimited losses without a hard risk floor
ADX lagging nature may cause entries at trend exhaustion points, increasing reversal risk
